items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Ray McChancey is mentioned by the [INTERVIEWER] as part of a list of people associated with the Bloomberg label and 'junk band', but the [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to this mention or discuss any personal interaction with Ray McChancey.

ctx.x: There was Victor. At the Bloomberg label. Yeah. Because I made a lot of things with the guys who used to sing. Ray McChancey? Yeah. Because they're all the junk band. Gene Feistino's played suitcase with us. Jack. Brunus.

Did you like Armstrong when you heard him? Oh, yes. But not as much as Oliver. No, not as much as Joe. He was a rough man. He was playing second chorus. He played beautiful. Joe broke him in and all. You know that part?
